editorial_blockers: Six original clips could not be previewed because Wikimedia returned HTTP 429, including crucial heron strike, wild giraffe browsing, live swallowtail study and lion-with-cubs clips.
Multiple sampled sources lack the tagged animal or claimed behavior during substantial portions of the clip; no safe verified seek windows or action evidence yet.
Several clips are distant, captive, dark, embedded-text or possibly near-static; cannot guarantee 8 relevant usable shots per story or <=8s cuts.
Lion cub play appears in one clearly relevant source only; two other wild cub sources show resting/walking, not wrestling.
Swallowtail controlled-study clip s002 samples apparatus without visible butterfly/bird action; live study s001 not previewed.
Great egret on captive alligator is authentic and visually confirmed; other wetland scenes need selection/replacements.
CC BY/CC0/PD license metadata and 40 distinct original hashes passed; TikTok attribution delivery and independent source-family checks still pending.
next_actions: Hourly QA should retry the six HTTP 429 sources with backoff and request video transcodes.
Replace mismatched/distant clips, or document precise action-window timestamps after reviewing full original video.
Re-run candidate semantic_shots.py, schema/narrative/license tests and original-hash uniqueness after every replacement.
Only then copy verified candidate to current main configs/daily.json after checking latest main and daily blob; leave publication_hold=true.
After fresh Daily 5 run, hourly QA alone inspects all five MP4s and manages TikTok scheduling/publication.
